title: MamaYuyu
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where the hero and the demon lord have made peace, the hero Corleo has become an empty figurehead. When a hero and a demon lord from another world suddenly appear, Corleo must deal with the chaos they bring. A four-volume Weekly Shonen Jump fantasy that MU lists as ended early.
life_message: Unclear from sources; it appears to ask what a hero is for once peace has come.
